confirm.title: Update {{name}}
confirm.description: TierPlan changes only the image of this service and keeps its other settings.
confirm.descriptionManaged: TierPlan pulls the new image and updates the service in place. This is saved as a new revision of {{stack}}, so you can roll back from History.
confirm.leftOut_one: {{count, number}} is skipped or ignored and won't change.

preflight.heading: Before you update
preflight.downtime: {{name}} runs 1 replica and Docker stops the old task before it starts the new one, so it will be down for a short time.
preflight.container_downtime: A container can't be replaced without stopping it, so {{name}} will be down for a short time.
preflight.no_healthcheck: {{name}}'s image has no health check. TierPlan can only tell the update worked if the new container is running, not that it is healthy.
preflight.host_ports: {{name}} publishes a port in host mode. A new task can't start on a node while the old one still holds the port.
preflight.volumes: {{name}} mounts a volume. The new version may change the data in it, and rolling back will not undo that.
preflight.previous_failure: This version failed before: {{reason}}. It was rolled back {{when}}.
preflight.previous_failure_pull: This version failed before: TierPlan couldn't pull the image. Nothing was changed. That was {{when}}.
preflight.previous_failure_noWhen: This version failed before: {{reason}}. It was rolled back.

confirm.note: If the update fails, TierPlan puts the previous version back on its own and records both in the audit log.

moved.title: A newer version appeared
moved.body: {{names}} changed again while you were looking. The list now shows the latest. Check it and choose Update again.

lock.stack: Another stack operation is running on {{environment}}: {{stack}}, started
lock.other: Another operation is running on {{environment}}, started

confirm.lockedToast: A deploy is running in {{environment}}. Try again when it finishes.

refusal.title: Nothing to update
refusal.agent: {{name}} is part of TierPlan and is updated by updating TierPlan.
refusal.job_mode: {{name}} is a job, which runs to completion, so there is nothing to update in place.
refusal.managed_by_stack: {{name}} belongs to a stack TierPlan manages. Update it from the stack.
refusal.not_checked: TierPlan has no check result for this image yet. Choose Check now first.
refusal.check_failed: The last check of this image failed. Choose Check now to try again.
refusal.pinned_in_file: The image reference in your compose file has a digest, so it never changes. Edit the file to move it.

refusal.task_container: {{name}} is a task of a service. Update the service instead; its tasks are replaced for you.

fleet.checked: Each item is checked again when its turn comes. One that has a newer version by then, or whose update failed before, is skipped and nothing is changed.
